subject: general
question:
Study the following bar graph and answer the question that follows.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d260d36b27e7efc3d6adb60eb224a86d1620a2dfd64e0c0df99664243982b88f.png] 

What is the growth rate in the number of accounts in 2013 as that of previous year?
solution:
Number of accounts opened in 2013 = 182.06

Number of accounts opened in 2012 = 138.50

Growth rate in the number of accounts in 2013 = [(182.06 - 138.50)/138.50] × 100

⇒(43.56/138.50) × 100

⇒31.45%

**∴ 31% is the growth rate in the number of accounts in 2013 as that of previous year.**
